definition.name: Wessel
definition.prompt: One character: who they are, health, mana and stamina (words, shown as bars), seven stats from 1 to 20, unspent points, Level 1 to 99 and XP to 100. The narrator sets health, mana, stamina and XP; the story cannot kill a character outright: they die only when they were already Down before a reply and are still Down at its end. The reader sets stats and points. XP at 100 raises the Level by one, up to the Level cap, and every third Level gives a point to spend on stats.

cards.title: The story ends here
cards.text: This character has died. Swipe or delete the reply that ended it to take that back.

The narrator names a skill with a learn line (name, what it does, stat, uses) and adds practice. At 100 practice the rank rises by one and practice starts again at 0; a Master stays at 100.
